facts.title: About 420 m
facts.text: Nearly three Harbour Centre towers! That spot is near Texada Island. Under our ferry, the sea is at most about 200 m deep.

facts.title: A narrow, rushing gap
facts.text: Tides pour through here, stirring up the water and food for fish and birds.

facts.title: Fresh water on top
facts.text: River water is lighter than salt water, so it spreads across the top like a muddy blanket.
